cd /workspace && cat > tools/test_wire.py <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
INV = [{'status':'invalid'}]

def L(x):
    return (x + '\n').encode(), INV

cases = [
    (b'{"op":"about"}\n', [{'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}]),
    (b'  {"op":"about"}  \n', [{'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}]),
    (b'{"op":"about"}\r\n', [{'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}]),
    (b'{"op":"about"}', [{'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}]),
    (b'\n', INV),
    (b'\r\n', INV),
    (b'   \n', INV),
    (b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"op":"about"}\n', INV),                       # BOM
    (b'{"op":"about","op":"about"}\n', INV),                      # duplicate key
    (b'{"op":"advance","time":NaN}\n', INV),
    (b'{"op":"advance","time":Infinity}\n', INV),
    (b'{"op":"advance","time":-Infinity}\n', INV),
    (b'{"op":"about"} {"op":"about"}\n', INV),
    (b'{"op":"about",}\n', INV),
    (b'{"op":"about}\n', INV),
    ('{"op":"about\'}}\n'.encode(), INV),
    (b'\xff\xfe{"op":"about"}\n', INV),                           # invalid utf-8
    (b'{"op":"advance","time":1e2}\n', INV),
    (b'{"op":"advance","time":1.0}\n', INV),
    (b'[1,2]\n', INV),
    (b'"about"\n', INV),
    (b'null\n', INV),
    (b'true\n', INV),
    (L('{"op": "advance", "time": -Infinity}')),
    (b'{"op":"audit","at":[0,1]}\n{"op":"about"}\n',
     [{'status':'error','code':'NOT_LOADED','rev':0},
      {'status':'ok','protocol':'forest-controller/3'}]),
]

bad = 0
for raw, want in cases:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN], input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                       stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    got = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
    if p.returncode != 0 or got != want:
        bad += 1
        print('FAIL', raw[:44], 'rc', p.returncode, got, want, p.stderr.decode()[:300])
print('wire bad', bad)

raw = (b'{"op":"load","n":3,"links":[[0,1,7]],"bookings":[]}\n'
       b'{broken\n'
       b'garbage\n'
       b'\n'
       b'{"op":"audit","at":[0]}\n')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN], input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                   stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
got=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
want=[{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},{'status':'invalid'},{'status':'invalid'},
      {'status':'invalid'},{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0,'leases':[],'samples':[[0,[7]]]}]
print('survival', 'PASS' if got==want else f'FAIL {got} != {want}')
PY
timeout 300 python3 -B tools/test_wire.py
